text:
amanda: FinEdge POC — they want to run orca-mini-10b (4-bit) in a private VPC. POC kickoff Wed 2026-04-01. Quick ask: any known catalog/ops blockers for orca-mini-10b 4-bit (latency, kv cache, memory, licensing)?

chen: I ran a compatibility sweep last month. orca-mini-10b + 4-bit quant is runnable on our q4 path but has two pain points: KV cold-starts on long contexts (>8k) and memory pressure if batch > 2. Seen throughput dip ~25% on first 50 tokens. :warning:

matt: drop the sweep output pls. also need a ballpark for Dedicated 2xA100 / 2-week POC (for pricing + overage policy).

amanda: quick command I ran locally: ```rci variant-check --model orca-mini-10b --quant 4bit --context 8192 --batch 2 --env private``` Summary output below.

chen: ```
compat: PASS
kv_cache: WARN cold-start latency spikes (~240ms per request initially)
memory: WARN batch>2 may exceed 40GB/GPU in some quant paths
throughput: ~12 tok/s steady, ~9 tok/s cold
```

chen: TL;DR: compatible but expect KV cold-starts and watch batch sizing. We have tunables (prefetch, prefix cache) that mitigate 60-80% of cold penalties.

julian: legal / licensing note — upstream Orca-mini license has ambiguous commercial terms. I opened a legal check; we need confirmation before shipping POC for a paying customer. I'll ping legal now.

amanda: SRE question — any infra blockers for VPC + HSM/KMS flow for this POC? @matt @chen

matt: VPC networking is fine. HSM/KMS: we require the customer's KMS cert for full HSM integration; for short POC we can use a customer-supplied key in our vault as a temporary workaround. I'll open an ops ticket. ETA ~48h to provision.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-4523 by matt — infra-ops assigned.

amanda: Action items: 1) @chen share full sweep logs + recommended quant knobs and prefetch settings; 2) @julian confirm legal clearance (or alternative license path); 3) @matt provision dedicated nodes + provide pricing estimate for 2-week POC. I'll coordinate scope w/ FinEdge and pause any model deployment until legal confirms. :white_check_mark:

chen: Uploading logs to /shared/poc/FinEdge/orca-mini-10b-sweep.log and attaching a small config snippet we used: ```quant_profiles:
  - name: 4bit-safe
    prefetch: true
    kv_prefetch_tokens: 64
    max_batch: 2
```

amanda: thanks. If legal blocks orca-mini, fallback option: recommend redwood-compat-7b family (lower mem, similar latency) for the POC to keep timeline. Will update FinEdge after legal reply.

matt: noted — I'll add fallback nodes to the provisioning ticket so we can flip quickly.

amanda: great. I'll post a short update to FinEdge and set a follow-up for Monday with results. Anyone else?

julian: pinged legal, adding them to the ticket. will update here when I hear back.

amanda: perfect — thanks all.
